title: Final Answers for Beta_0
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for beta_0 as derived from conservation laws.

title: Final Answers for Epsilon_0
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for epsilon_0 based on the invariant mass-energy relation.

title: Calculation of Beta_0
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate beta_0 using the provided values for m_1, m_2, and beta_1.

title: Calculation of Epsilon_0
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate epsilon_0 using the rest mass values and the derived expression.

title: Laboratory Speed Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the laboratory speed beta_l using the transformation equations.

title: Laboratory Direction Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the laboratory direction theta_l based on the velocity components.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the calculations of beta_0 and epsilon_0.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations, especially when converting to MeV.

title: Nonrelativistic Approximation Justification
description: Optional Criteria: The student should justify the use of nonrelativistic approximations in the final calculations.
